prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic high-fashion studio portrait of three original approved adult women in a symmetrical coordinated trio composition.
prompt.main_subject: Three distinct original approved adult women: two kneeling at opposite sides in glossy light-pink long-sleeve high-neck bodysuits with subtle white curved line patterns and white platform high-top sneakers, while the central woman stands with crossed arms in a glossy black version of the same outfit. Preserve distinct faces, natural skin texture, varied brunette-to-blonde hair, and direct editorial eye contact.
composition_elements: Two side subjects kneel with knees together, hands on the floor in front, and bodies leaning forward; the central subject stands tall between them with crossed arms.
Minimal light-gray studio background with a visible smooth floor and balanced negative space.
Preserve the pink-black wardrobe contrast, glossy reflections, symmetrical hierarchy, and clear three-person count.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright clean softbox lighting with even frontal exposure, controlled highlights on glossy fabric, gentle floor shadows, and refined high-fashion cover atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 group portrait, medium-format camera with 80mm lens at f/8, sharp facial and textile detail, natural pores, subtle analog grain, clean neutral color grade, no text or watermark.
